instruction.text: Valentina wrote a restaurant review for her English class. Read her review and answer the following questions.

atoms.title: Valentina’s Review: Johnny’s Jamaican Restaurant in Brooklyn, New York

atoms.text: Last Saturday afternoon, my dad and I had lunch at a new place in town: Johnny’s Jamaican Restaurant. My dad is Jamaican, and we visit our family on the island every year.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+3st'>Last Saturday afternoon, my dad and I had lunch at a new place in town, Johnny’s Jamaican Restaurant. My dad is Jamaican, and we visit our family on the island every year.</prosody>

atoms.text: My dad and I adore Jamaican food and were both thrilled when we discovered a place to eat our favourite food right near our flat. The atmosphere in Johnny’s was great; a pleasant scent and calming Reggae music greets you as you enter. We were seated at a nice table by the window and greeted by a kind waitress named May. We ordered curried goat, rice and peas, two patties and two lemonades. Our food came after a short wait, and it was beyond delicious! My dad said the curried goat was the best he’d ever had in the US, and the patties were phenomenal.

The atmosphere in Johnny’s was great; a pleasant scent and calming Reggae music greets you as you enter. We were seated at a nice table by the window and greeted by a kind waitress named May. We ordered curried goat, rice and peas, two patties and two lemonades. Our food came after a short wait, and it was beyond delicious! My dad said the curried goat was the best he’d ever had in the US and the patties were phenomenal.</prosody>

atoms.text: Overall, our experience at Johnny’s Jamaican Restaurant was excellent. We will definitely be back soon, and next time we will bring the whole family!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+3st'>Overall, our experience at Johnny’s Jamaican Restaurant was excellent. We will definitely be back soon, and we will bring the whole family next time!</prosody>

atoms.a: What is the purpose of this text?
b: ++to describe the delicious food and persuade others to visit the restaurant
to describe the restaurant and entertain readers with funny stories
to inform readers about different types of Jamaican food

atoms.a: Which point of view is the text told in?
b: alternates between third-person and first-person point of view

atoms.a: Which sentence best summarises Valentina’s opinion of the food?
b: “The atmosphere in Johnny’s is great; a pleasant scent greets you as you enter and calming Reggae music plays from the speakers”
++“Our food came after a short wait, and it was beyond delicious! My dad said the curried goat was the best he’d ever had in the US and the patties were phenomenal.”
“We will definitely be back soon, and next time, we’re bringing the whole family!”

atoms.a: Which elements does this review include?
